results.name: app_help
results.output_tail:
resolves app/map/task/graph and
prints the filled 3D task. Execute starts roscore + Gazebo (optional),
launches the graph Assembly, publishes the task start/goal, monitors the
global path/local trajectory/carrier and writes a JSON record. The support-map
marker node is started when app.visualization.markers.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --app APP
  --out OUT
  --execute
  --no-gazebo
  --gui
  --port PORT
  --timeout-s TIMEOUT_S
  --trace-out TRACE_OUT
                        opt-in full observation JSON; capture failure fails
                        this run
  --real                use the on-robot ROS master and live sensors; no
                        roscore, no gazebo, no harness obstacle/hold
                        publishers
  --interactive         keep the 3D stack alive; RViz Publish Point selects
                        goals
  --rviz                start RViz with fixtures/rviz/nav3d.rviz (implies
                        interactive)

results.name: inflate_help
results.output_tail:
usage: inflate_support_map.py [-h] --map MAP --out OUT --map-id MAP_ID
                              [--version VERSION] [--margin MARGIN]
                              [--register]

Inflate support_map footprints by a fixed XY margin for stair execution. The
local planner keeps the body center inside a surface shrunk by its radius;
adjacent stair treads with only a few centimetres of overlap therefore leave a
dead band. This tool produces a navigation variant with footprints widened by
the requested margin. It is a map preprocessing step, not a new map claim.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --map MAP
  --out OUT
  --map-id MAP_ID
  --version VERSION
  --margin MARGIN
  --register
